title_pattern: Is the Ingham County unemployment rate above {{param.x}}% for the last month of {{period}}?
event_definition_pattern: The BLS LAUS unemployment rate for Ingham County, MI (not seasonally adjusted, as published by FRED as MIINGH5URN) for the last month of {{period}} is greater than {{param.x}} percent. The window is {{period_start}} to {{period_end}}.

title_pattern: Do Michigan building permits in {{period}} exceed the same quarter one year earlier?
event_definition_pattern: The sum of monthly new private housing units authorized by building permits in Michigan (Census BPS, FRED MIBPPRIV, not seasonally adjusted) for {{period}} is greater than the sum for the same quarter one year earlier.
